original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚被绑架NYSC成员家属向联邦政府求助
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚一名刚结束国家青年服务团（NYSC）服务的成员在Ijebu-Ode至Ibadan公路上被绑架，其家属向联邦政府及安全部门求助。据家属称，绑匪最初索要2000万奈拉赎金，后提高至2500万奈拉，并给出24小时付款期限。家属表示已向Ijebu-Ode警察局报案。该事件目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 一名刚结束NYSC服务的成员在Ijebu-Ode至Ibadan公路上被绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A family of one of the 10 recently discharged National Youth Service Corps members abducted on the Ijebu-Ode-Ibadan Road

key_facts.fact: 绑匪最初索要2000万奈拉赎金，后提高至2500万奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the kidnappers initially reached out to the family, demanding a ransom of N20m, but later raised it to N25m, with a deadline of 24 hours to make the payment
Although the matter has been reported at the Ijebu-Ode Police Station

key_facts.fact: 家属向联邦政府及安全部门求助
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: have appealed to the Federal Government and security operatives to help rescue their son, Dapo

uncertainties: 被绑架人数（10人）及具体细节尚未获独立来源确认
目前仅单一来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
